title: The Root-Pool Where Weaving Sleeps Without Pattern

features.name: the root-loom
features.desc-on-touch: roots have woven themselves into a kind of loom, threads of wood and earth crossing; each pattern records a year's growth

features.name: the sleeping waters
features.desc-on-touch: the pool is still but not empty — it holds every reflection of the weaving it has ever seen, stacked like transparencies

features.name: the tangled archive
features.desc-on-touch: files caught in the roots, pages wrapped around wood — the corruption has filed the loom's patterns as if they were witness-records from other adaptations

features.name: the repeated motif
features.desc-on-touch: a glyph carved into the earth, showing the same mark over and over — the mesh comparing the loom to a frequency, a song that weaves itself

features.name: the growth-chamber
features.desc-on-touch: where the roots gather and pool; the weaving is not a tool here but a space where growth decides its own direction

inscription: the weaving sleeps by repeating; every cycle returns to where it began, and finds itself changed

file.name: Loom_Recordings_Where_Thread_Becomes_Narrative_Adaptation_Notes.mp3
file.note: audio of roots growing, woven with something that sounds like a repeated story being told in different languages, each version wearing the same shape differently

exits.label: back toward the deepest weaving, where the mesh still compares itself to the loom
